statement: The College invites proposals for a cloud electronic signature service.
quote: Kestrel Vale Community College (the College) invites proposals for a cloud electronic signature service.

statement: The service replaces paper forms for enrollment, financial aid and staff contracts.
quote: The service replaces paper forms for enrollment, financial aid and staff contracts.

statement: The College serves about 6,400 students on two campuses and employs 410 staff.
quote: The College serves about 6,400 students on two campuses and employs 410 staff.

statement: Since 2019 the College has collected signatures with a hosted forms tool whose contract ends on 2027-03-31.
quote: Since 2019 the College has collected signatures with a hosted forms tool whose contract ends on 2027-03-31.

statement: About 38,000 signed records are held in that tool.
quote: About 38,000 signed records are held in that tool.

statement: Previous suppliers have generally held ISO 27001 certification.
quote: Previous suppliers have generally held ISO 27001 certification.

statement: The College plans to replace its student records system during 2027, and the replacement has not yet been chosen.
quote: The College plans to replace its student records system during 2027, and the replacement has not yet been chosen.

statement: The College is closed from 2026-12-19 to 2027-01-04, and no staff are available for testing or training in that period.
quote: The College is closed from 2026-12-19 to 2027-01-04, and no staff are available for testing or training in that period.

statement: Proposals must be submitted through the College's procurement portal as a single PDF of no more than 20 pages by 2026-12-01 12:00 UTC.
quote: Proposals must be submitted through the College's procurement portal as a single PDF of no more than 20 pages by 2026-12-01 12:00 UTC.

statement: Section 7 describes how proposals are scored.
quote: Section 7 describes how proposals are scored.

statement: The requirements in this section apply for the whole contract term.
quote: The requirements in this section apply for the whole contract term.

statement: The Supplier shall keep an audit record of every signature event, including the signer's identity, the time and the document version.
quote: The Supplier shall keep an audit record of every signature event, including the signer's identity, the time and the document version.

statement: The Supplier supports signing on current desktop and mobile browsers.
quote: support signing on current desktop and mobile browsers

statement: The Supplier sends a reminder to each signer who has not signed within 72 hours.
quote: send a reminder to each signer who has not signed within 72 hours.

statement: The Supplier should provide templates for the College's twelve most used forms.
quote: The Supplier should provide templates for the College's twelve most used forms.

statement: The Supplier stores signed documents for ten years.
quote: The Supplier shall store signed documents for ten (10) years.

statement: The Supplier should migrate the signed records held in the current tool by 2027-02-28.
quote: The Supplier should migrate the signed records held in the current tool by 2027-02-28.

statement: The service must integrate with the College's student records system through its existing REST API.
quote: The service must integrate with the College's student records system through its existing REST API.

statement: A bidder may propose an on-premises deployment option.
quote: Bidders may propose an on-premises deployment option.

statement: The service shall be available 99.5% of the time in each calendar month, excluding planned maintenance announced five working days in advance.
quote: The service shall be available 99.5% of the time in each calendar month, excluding planned maintenance announced five working days in advance.

statement: The Supplier should respond to severity-one incidents within one hour, at any time of day.
quote: The Supplier should respond to severity-one incidents within one hour, at any time of day.

statement: Contract award is planned for 2026-12-15; this states background schedule information.
quote: Contract award is planned for 2026-12-15.

statement: The service must be live for students by 2027-01-11, the first day of spring enrollment.
quote: The service must be live for students by 2027-01-11, the first day of spring enrollment.

statement: Proposals are scored on the criteria below.
quote: Proposals are scored on the criteria below.

statement: Criterion and weight headings provide background for the scoring criteria.
quote: Criterion | Weight

statement: Technical approach has a weight of 40%.
quote: Technical approach | 40%

statement: Service levels and support has a weight of 20%.
quote: Service levels and support | 20%

statement: Integration and migration has a weight of 20%.
quote: Integration and migration | 20%

statement: Price has a weight of 20%.
quote: Price | 20%

statement: The contract runs for three years from award, with an option to extend it by one year.
quote: The contract runs for three years from award, with an option to extend it by one year.
